what: R1 anchor-hop expansion α/θ calibration sweep (PLAN_audit5Public2026 'Hard parts — R1'; SPEC.md --for retrieval addendum). TRAIN split ONLY — the frozen repo-disjoint A7 split (dataset.lock, salted SHA-256, byte0<128=train). Held-out was never touched during calibration; the acceptance comparison ran once, after these constants were baked.
dataset: czlll/Loc-Bench_V1 test split, n=560, train slice n=317 (87 repos)
baseline: same binary with CTXPACK_NO_ANCHORHOP=1 (gate-proven byte-identical to the pre-R1 binary on --for/--no-route/name-exact/plain map: test/anchorhopcheck.sh + nr/ne/map diffs vs a main-built binary)
combination_rule_finding: hop mass to a candidate = MAX over supporting edges, not SUM. Summing lets a hub shared by many anchors (utility helper, __init__ import target) accumulate several anchors' worth of mass and outrank the true top lexical hits — measured train strict@1 27.1% -> 8.2% with sum at α=0.2. Max bounds any candidate at α·topAnchorScore (α<1 means a hop-only candidate can never displace the #1 hit) and is order-independent.
metric_note: deltas are paired per-instance vs baseline (summarize: strict file@k = all primary gold files within top-k; lenient = any gold in top-10; fn-MRR = first-hit reciprocal rank). Wall deltas from these sweep runs are cache-state artifacts (shared index/OS caches across serial+parallel lanes) and were NOT used for any decision; latency evidence comes from the held-out release runs only.
rationale: strict@10 (the gate metric) plateaus at +0.95pp across α∈[0.05,0.15] and declines above; @1/MRR damage grows monotonically with α (−5.36pp @1 by α=0.4). α=0.10 is the mid-plateau point: @10 at the plateau max, @1 exactly flat, MRR −0.04pp (noise), plus small @3/@5 gains. θ is not binding under the max-combination rule (identical metrics at θ=0.25/0.50/0.75, α=0.2); 0.50 kept as the decided default.

heldout_acceptance.protocol: one shot after constants chosen on train — bench/locbench/run_locbench.py --n 560 --split heldout --arms for --latency-samples 5 --measure-cold --measure-index; baseline = same binary CTXPACK_NO_ANCHORHOP=1; candidate = α=0.10/θ=0.50 baked; runs sequential and alone (no concurrent load)
heldout_acceptance.paired_deltas: strict file@10 +0.41pp with clustered-bootstrap 95% LOWER BOUND +0.00pp; lenient +0.82pp; MRR −0.0012; multi-file +0.00pp; warm p50 +2.8% p95 +10.2%; token p50 +0.2% p95 +2.7%; cold +1.6%/+11.1%; index +1.8%/+12.7%
heldout_acceptance.verdict: REJECT — tier-1 PASS (warm p95 761.5≤775 ms, cold 1623.8≤1650 ms); tier-2 FAIL (quality LB +0.00pp / weighted cost +1.50% = ratio 0.000 vs min 2.5). The +0.41pp point estimate is not statistically distinguishable from zero, and the p95 latency tails (+10-13%) are the real price of disabling MaxScore pruning on the conceptual route (the expansion is a full-distribution consumer).
heldout_acceptance.outcome: NOT SHIPPED — the ranking change was reverted per the B3 negative-result rule (PLAN_audit5Public2026 R1: 'if it fails the gate, it lands nowhere'). The exact candidate diff, the R1 gate script + fixture, both held-out release JSONs, and the comparator verdict are archived in bench/locbench/results/r1_anchorhop/ for reproduction or a future retry.
